title: NumPy Mathematical Functions & Pipeline Simulator
description: Visualize memory allocation, scalar broadcasting, array aggregations, absolute deviations, and combined mathematical pipelines.

steps.title: Allocate Raw Marks Array in Memory
steps.explanation: NumPy allocates a contiguous 1D block of 5 integers in memory. Each index [0..4] stores an individual student exam score.

steps.title: Vectorized Scalar Bonus Addition
steps.explanation: NumPy broadcasts scalar value 5 across all 5 elements in parallel without an explicit for-loop: 72+5=77, 85+5=90, 91+5=96, 68+5=73, 79+5=84.

steps.title: Compute Total Sum Aggregation
steps.explanation: np.sum() executes a reduction aggregation across all array elements: 77 + 90 + 96 + 73 + 84 = 420. The result is a single scalar number.

steps.title: Compute Class Mean Average
steps.explanation: np.mean() calculates the central tendency: total sum (420) divided by array length (5) = 84.0 (returned as float64).

steps.title: Element-Wise Deviations from Class Benchmark
steps.explanation: NumPy subtracts scalar average 84.0 from each element in updated: 77-84 = -7.0, 90-84 = +6.0, 96-84 = +12.0, 73-84 = -11.0, 84-84 = 0.0.

steps.title: Apply np.abs() to Measure Error Magnitude
steps.explanation: np.abs() evaluates every element in diff and strips the negative signs, leaving pure variance magnitudes: |-7|=7, |6|=6, |12|=12, |-11|=11, |0|=0.

steps.title: Chaining Operations: 2D Euclidean Distance
steps.explanation: Chained mathematical pipeline: x and y arrays are squared with np.square(), added element-wise with +, and passed into np.sqrt(). For (3, 4), sqrt(9 + 16) = 5.0.
